summary: Iteration 8 verified the expo-notifications Expo Go Android crash fix (lazy guarded require in notificationService.ts). All 4 review-request items PASS. (1) BOOT: fresh load of the public preview URL shows the onboarding splash ('HERA / tap anywhere to begin') at /onboarding with ZERO page errors, no red screen, no 'missing the required default export' warnings, no ErrorBoundary crash. Metro log confirmed: crash entries (expo-notifications import throw, missing default export for all 5 tab routes, 'Cannot read property ErrorBoundary of undefined') exist only BEFORE the last bundler restart (old pre-fix bundle, expo.out.log lines 3092-3183); zero errors after restart at line 3228. (2) SETTINGS: logged in as delivered@resend.dev via UI OTP (4-digit override 1234 via mongo code_hash poller per test_credentials.md) -> profile tab -> Settings renders fully (profile card, Hera Monthly plan, Cloud Sync signed-in, Appearance, DAILY REMINDERS with Morning Affirmation + Evening Reflection switches, Account, Legal). Toggling Morning switch -> 'Mobile Only' alert ('Daily reminders work in the Hera app on your phone.') rendered, dismissed with OK, switch correctly stays OFF (Platform.OS==='web' early-return at profile.tsx:524). Same for Evening switch. No crash, no stuck state. (3) CODE REVIEW of notificationService.ts: guard is watertight - module-level `let Notifications=null; try{ require('expo-notifications') }catch{}` (lines 7-13) correctly contains the synchronous import-time throw Expo Go Android produces; every consumer is null-guarded: setNotificationHandler via `Notifications?.` (line 39), initNotifications `if(!n) return false` (51), requestNotificationPermissions `if(!n) return 'unavailable'` (68), scheduleReminder `if(!n) return` (87), cancelReminder via `Notifications?.` (112), refreshReminders `if(!Notifications) return` (122). All HeraContext call sites (refreshReminders line 240 with .catch, updateNotifMorning/Evening lines 465-475) are safe when the module is absent. (4) SMOKE: Home, Discover, Vision Board, Journal tabs all render fully after login (daily affirmation computed = HeraContext chain intact). No page errors in any of 3 browser runs.

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG: notificationService.ts did a top-level `import * as Notifications from 'expo-notifications'`; expo-notifications throws synchronously at import time inside Expo Go on Android (SDK 53 removed remote push from Expo Go), killing the module graph via HeraContext -> _layout and cascading into expo-router 'missing default export' warnings for all tab routes and 'TypeError: Cannot read property ErrorBoundary of undefined'. FIX (verified): lazy guarded require (`let Notifications=null; try{Notifications=require('expo-notifications')}catch{}`) with every exported function and the module-level setNotificationHandler call null-guarded; on failure initNotifications returns false, requestNotificationPermissions returns 'unavailable', schedule/cancel/refresh no-op. UI surfaces 'Mobile Only' (web, runtime-verified) / 'Preview Limitation' (Expo Go) alerts instead of crashing. Cannot runtime-verify the Android Expo Go path in this environment (web preview loads the web shim successfully), but the containment pattern is provably correct for a synchronous import-time throw.
